blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines remains committed to the global “30×30” goal of conserving at least 30 percent of Earth’s land, freshwater, and oceans by 2030, as set in 2022 under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. Secretary Juan Miguel “Mitch” Cuna of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) reaffirmed this last week during the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) Leaders Event for Nature and People, stressing that safeguarding biodiversity is crucial to the Philippines’ survival. Speaking before world leaders in New York City, Cuna said: “As an archipelagic and megadiverse country, we recognize that protecting nature is not […]...
